summary: Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. (DAAQ), a Cayman SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing an October 7, 2026 merger agreement with Titan Strategics Holdings Ltd, a Cayman company whose subsidiary holds ~207 km2 of exploration permits in Sweden's Billingen-Falbygden region. DAAQ will domesticate into Delaware and rename itself Renaissance Nuclear, Inc.; a new Merger Sub will merge into Titan, which survives. DAAQ's board unanimously approved and recommended the deal. No price, premium, exchange ratio, or closing date was disclosed in the excerpt. Watch for the proxy/de-SPAC timeline, redemptions, PIPE needs, and Nasdaq listing mechanics.
